info.name: OAN Master Data Service - End to End
info.description:
# Master Data Service end-to-end test (New Dev)

Select the **OAN Master Data - New Dev** environment and run the whole collection with one iteration.

## Two users are needed
MDS approves changes with maker-checker inside the service. The person who edits or submits a draft cannot approve it.

* `maker_username` / `maker_password`: a staff user with the **MASTER_DATA_ADMIN** role on the `master-data` client.
* `checker_username` / `checker_password`: a different staff user with **MASTER_DATA_APPROVER** or **MASTER_DATA_ADMIN**.

Put these in local (current) values only. Tokens stay in run-time variables. Both users sign in through staff IAM (login provider 1) and Keycloak, the same way as the registry collection. MDS takes the token as a Bearer header and does not need a CSRF header.

## What it covers
1. Service health and API description.
2. Read-only coverage of the legacy `/geo` and `/attributes` APIs and the versioned `/catalogue` (versions, levels, units, P-code lookup, change history, datasets, values, audit trail).
3. **Location rename with approval.** The maker renames the location in `geo_unit_id` (default kebele ET02010101) in a draft and submits it. The run checks that the published name has not changed yet, that a submitted draft is locked, that the maker cannot approve their own change and that rejection needs a note. The checker approves, and the run confirms the new name in the catalogue, in the legacy geo API the registries read, in the change history (RENAME) and in the audit trail. The previous version keeps the old name.
4. **Restore.** The original name goes back through the same flow (`restore_after_test=true`).
5. **Dataset value change with approval** and its restore, using `list_code` or the first published flat dataset with no open draft.

## Safety
* Nothing changes unless `enable_writes=true`.
* The location flow is skipped when any geography draft is already open, so nobody else's draft is touched. A dataset with an open draft is never chosen.
* If a run stops half-way, run folders 01 and 08 together. It discards only the draft this run opened.
* Each approval publishes a new version. A full run with restore adds two geography versions and two versions of the chosen dataset. Published versions cannot be deleted.
